name: Fairy Cakes
text:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

---
This bite-sized rectangular honey or ginger patisserie is a common fey amusement often coated with multicolored sugar crystals. When you consume a fairy cake, a random part of your body morphs into a caricature of yourself (such as an elongated nose or tiny hands). Roll 1d4 to determine the area of the body it affects:
- head

- appendages

- torso

- skin.

This transformation lasts for 1 hour, during which you gain a +2 status bonus to Deception checks to impersonate a creature other than yourself.

Effect: Fairy Cakes
